This move suggests that investors are seeking safe-haven assets in the face of rising interest rates.

The yen's resilience was also seen as a response to Japan's Prime Minister's comments on boosting confidence in the currency.

On one hand, the US economy's Q2 growth and rising PCE inflation in August suggested a strengthening economy, which could boost gold prices. On the other hand, the monthly decline in gold prices and the recent rise in gold prices after cooler inflation data may have led to a cautious approach by traders, resulting in the price drop.
